RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.9.1 (versionCode 10)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: ff9efbf7f992a01c44866b880ec0ee001c40a680de48233cf168a4c8cb2b0e8f
Size: 24929450 bytes

Changes in 0.9.1:
- Main quick controls are fixed on one screen with no horizontal swipe.
- LIVE / SINGLE / TONE / MENU and tone modes are all visible at once.
- FREQ input fields are taller and no longer clip the number.
- Manual scale range uses a clear connector instead of double periods.
- RBW and VBW/AVG options wrap to the next line and align left.
- FREQ / LEVEL / MARKER / MEASURE / CONFIG tabs are visually separated from content.
- Added the 850k RBW option.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
